object.attr: stakeholder: commits stay explicit, so a person can review an agent's changes before they enter history; the editing functions write files and the caller commits. The git index too, because a staged file leaks into the person's next commit (review Q14). An empty or blank message is refused instead (MELLON-MCP-SRS-80).
object.description: When a write tool call gives no `commit_message`, or gives null, the MCP server shall leave the commits, branches and git index unchanged.
